context: The RV32Q Standard Extension instruction set listing specifies the binary encodings for quad-precision floating-point operations including FLQ, FSQ, FMADD.Q, FMSUB.Q, FADD.Q, FSUB.Q, FMUL.Q, FDIV.Q, FSQRT.Q, FSGNJ variants, FMIN.Q, FMAX.Q, and FCVT.S.Q.
